[b]NEW WITH THE 2.0.0 UPDATE - NOT COMPATIBLE WITH PREVIOUS SAVES CONTAINING VERSION 1.0.0!!! 
[/b]You can safely add Version 2.0.0 to any save file not containing Version 1.0.0 of this mod.  Attempting to replace the previous version of this mod will generate error items.
[b]

[b]Compatibility[/b]
Should be compatible with all crop mods.

[b]Future Plans
[/b]Making it this far has been a labor of love. A lot of time was spent learning to code and create pixel art- this is the first time I've done either.  In future, once I've learned a little more, I'd like to add some magical effects as alluded to by the text descriptions, as well as giant crops and [b]recipes (complete)[/b].  Also, as I play with Even Better Artisan Goods, I'd like to eventually add a supporting mod for that.  Finally, a Whimsical Witch Garden- Flowers mod could be posted one day.  I already have a list of ideas! 

[b]Thanks[/b]
Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2821799]MizuJakkaru[/url] of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia- More Crops[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/60773651]SakakiYumiko[/url] of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27726]Yumiko's Extra Crops[/url] whose mods I used as references, and to the Stardew Valley Discord community who helped me many times when I got stuck.  Please note, some select crops are intentionally similar in style to Cornucopia to aid with immersion when playing with both mods active.  It is my intention to pay homage, rather than copy, and I hope that I have accomplished this adequately.
